ios.desc:
Imagine a Venn diagram where one circle is people who are learning their ABC's, and the second circle is people who are interested in esoteric science terms.  That place where they do not overlap - that is the target audience for this app.  
This app is silly, but fun.  We bet you will learn a few things from this app - everything from computer science terms, to geology, physics, biology and much more.

The app is a collection of 26 pages, each page with a beautiful image and a word to learn.  Can you identify which science each word comes from?
